newsitem.title: UK: Blair to speak at TUC conference in September.
newsitem.headline: Blair to speak at TUC conference in September.

text.p: Prime Minister Tony Blair will address British union delegates on September 9 in Brighton, on the south coast of England, the Trades Union Congress (TUC) said on Monday.
Blair will attend the second full day of the TUC's annual congress and will be the first Labour prime minister to do so since 1978.

Other speakers include EU social affairs commissioner Padraig Flynn, British foreign secretary Robin Cook, education and employment secretary David Blunkett and Adair Turner, director general of the Confederation of British Industry (CBI).
